summary.title: Realtime Django Part 6: Build a Chat application RabbitMQ and uWSGI websockets (Extras)
summary.one_liner: You learn how to add a loading screen, auto-scroll and sound notifications to a Vue chat front end, and how to switch Django djoser auth to short-lived JWTs with silent token refresh.
keywords: chat notification sound when tab not focused
json web tokens django rest framework
takeaways: Use a loading state and the Vue updated hook to show a loader and auto-scroll new messages into view.
Play an audio notification when the document is not focused, placing the audio file in the static folder.
Switch djoser from DRF tokens to JWT by installing a JWT extension, using the /jwt/create endpoint and the JWT Authorization header.
Keep JWTs short-lived and refresh them on an interval (every 240 seconds in the example) so chats are not interrupted.
summary.summary: This extras post from Part 6 of a realtime Django chat series covers frontend polish and backend security. On the frontend it adds a loading state with a loader screen, auto-scrolls the chat window using Vue's updated lifecycle hook, and plays a sound when the tab is unfocused. On the backend it moves djoser authentication to JSON web tokens, explains that default tokens do not expire, and sets up a refresh endpoint called every 4 minutes from the Vue component. The author notes that the refresh endpoint is obscured for basic protection and that secret keys must be guarded.
